reports.description: Structural deterioration at 120 Horodotska Street requires immediate attention. Large plaster sections are falling from the building facade, creating potential hazards for pedestrians below. This has been ongoing for several months and poses liability concerns for the property owner and the municipality. Urgent remediation is needed.

reports.title: Plaster Falling From Building
reports.description: Why havent you guys fixed this?? Plaster is falling of the building on Horodotska 120 and nobody does anything abot it. Fix it now

reports.location: at the corner of Horodotska Street
reports.title: Eastern Wall Damage and Debris Risk
reports.description: Chunks of plaster are falling from the facade at 120 Horodotska Street. The damage covers the entire eastern wall, approximately 3 meters high and 2 meters wide. It has been deteriorating for at least 6 months, possibly longer. Pedestrians below are at significant risk from falling debris.

reports.title: Crumbling Building on Horodotska Street
reports.description: Honestly, I'm so worried about the facade crumbling at 120 Horodotska. Every time it rains, more pieces fall off. It's pretty dangerous for kids playing nearby, don't you think?

reports.title: Building Plaster Falling
reports.description: Facade at Horodotska 120 is falling apart, like there's plaster everywhere on the sidewalk. It's been going on for months or whatever. Dunno who's supposed to fix it but yeah it's bad

reports.location: Stryiska Street 108, near the entrance of the building
reports.title: Pack of stray dogs scaring residents
reports.description: So we have this group of about five or six stray dogs hanging around the yard, and honestly they have gotten quite aggressive lately. Yesterday evening around seven they chased a woman with grocery bags, barking and jumping. Mornings are the worst when kids walk to school. Could someone please send animal control over? Thank you so much!

reports.title: Dogs went crazy today
reports.description: Bro these dogs are INSANE?? like four of them lunged at me walking home from the bus, I literally ran. my hands were shaking. somebody needs to do something before one of them actually bites a kid I swear

reports.title: Stray dogs in the courtyard
reports.description: Several stray dogs reside in the courtyard. They growl at passersby and sometimes bark loudly in the morning. I have lived here many years and ask the city to kindly take appropriate measures.

reports.title: Aggressive strays, again
reports.description: Reported the dogs before. Nothing changed.

reports.location: Stryiska street, by the corner near number 108
reports.title: Not sure who to tell about dogs
reports.description: Kinda new to the area and dunno if this is the right place, but there's like a bunch of street dogs by the building and they bark and run at people. One snapped at me yesterday. Who handles this stuff?

reports.title: Huge dent in the road
reports.description: Huge dent in the road near Zelena 15. A significant sunken area in the asphalt has created a large dent in the roadway. The defect is marked with white and red paint.

reports.title: Burnt out bulb
reports.description: Burnt out bulb. The streetlight bulb near 15 Zelena Street is burnt out and does not illuminate the area.

reports.title: Courtyard lights not on
reports.description: Lights not on (and broken?) in the courtyard at 12 Stusa Street. Multiple lamps in the courtyard are not turning on and may be broken. This affects the pedestrian lighting between the buildings.

reports.title: Overflowing city trash can
reports.description: Overflowing city trash can at Virmenska 7. The public trash can is full to capacity with garbage overflowing from the openings and piled on top.
